title: YOu have to be kidding
text:
YOu have to be kidding. This unit does produce a fine spray of oil. However, there are some bad problems. For starters, the opening at the top to fill it is about the size of my pinky fingertip. I could not even get my funnel into it. Filling it proved messy and wasteful of good olive oil. The other big problem is that the unit shoots most of the spray off to one side. This makes if difficult to aim and apoly a uniform coating.

I would suggest a sprayer that has a larger opening for easier filling at a minimum.
